About this item

  • CLASSIC RETRO DESIGN: 90s oval sunglasses for women men have been very popular among the public. As a kind of vintage sunglasses, the small oval sunglasses looks more trendy and elegant.
  • SMALL OVAL AND CAT-EYE STYLE: Breaksun's Vintage women's oval sunglasses are perfect for all the super cool fashionistas, models and bloggers. The combination of oval and cat eye makes this sunglasses look so unique and fashionable.
  • TRENDY OVAL SUNGLASSES: This round retro sunglasses chunky frame sun shades for small face, also fit for teen girls and teen boys. You can wear the oval funny sunglasses for a bunch of different outfits.
  • 100% UV 400 PROTECTION: The lenses of this classic oval sunglasses for women men can block 100% UVA and UVB rays, help restore true color, protect your eyes and pamper yourself with a more accurate visual experience!
  • RELIABLE SERVICE: If you have any questions about our products, please feel free to contact with us and we will reply you within 24 hours. All Breaksun customers enjoy our lifetime warranty on glasses, no risk of trying.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers love these sunglasses for their cute retro vibe, great quality, and exceptional value for money. They are versatile, going with everything, and customers find them durable, with one mentioning they've survived their kids. The sun protection receives mixed feedback - while some say they block a good amount of sunlight, others report seeing glare through the top of the frames. The fit and shape also get mixed reviews, with some finding them good for smaller faces while others say they're too small, and while some love the shape, others report the arms being crooked.

    Cute shape but flat lenses created strange reflections I couldn't handle
    Reviewed in the United States on July 25, 2025
    Color: 2 Pack (Black/Grey+yellow Tortoise/Brown)Lens Width: 54 Millimeters

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    I really wanted to like these sunglasses. The shape is so cute and I like they way they look on me. In fact, I like the look so much that I kept wearing them long after I realized I had a problem with them.

    Here's the problem, the lenses are flat, which I don't think has ever been the case in sunglasses I've worn--they always have at least a little curve to them. I realized that the flat lenses create these odd reflections that just catch my eye in my peripheral vision on both sides and makes me think I'm seeing motion where there isn't anything. I finally stopped wearing them not only because they made me crazy but also because it wasn't safe for me to drive with them on.
